messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: attempt to unpin runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 for quantized-llama3x on canary group B at 2024-04-09T22:00:00Z. Rollout id r-241: start +5% canary, conditional escalation.
Alice Nguyen: quick context — v2.15 includes kvcache eviction fix and kernel shuffle. We saw a 4% average token latency improvement in bench runs.
Mateo Rios: note: SDK 1.12 clients still assume old cache behavior. If runtime unpin changes response framing we might need sdk shim.
Priya Sharma: can we do a split unpin? runtime unpin on GPU pool A, keep SDK pinned behavior on API layer via shim for 24h.
Jenna (oncall): +1 for split, but need a clear rollback plan and smoke tests. I'm on call during the window.
Viktor Ivankov: I'll prepare the canary smoke checklist. Key checks: cold-start 99th latency, streaming token continuity, function-calling payload hashes.
Alice Nguyen: checklist snippet:```
- POST /v1/generate simple prompt (latency < 180ms p95)
- Streaming test: ensure chunk order intact and no duplicate tokens
- Eval set: 120 prompts run, quality delta < 1.5%
```
Mateo Rios: FYI logs from the last canary where we unpinned a different model showed a rare OOM on longseqs. Add long-seq generator to tests.
Priya Sharma: Agreed. Also add metric: sdk-error-rate (client-side decoding errors) and model-version-mismatch logs.
deploy-bot: Rollout plan r-241: canary 5% -> monitor 30min -> if green escalate to 25% -> monitor 1h -> full. Autopause on regressions: any of [latency_p95 > baseline*1.2, quality_delta > 2.0%, error_rate > 0.5%]
Jenna (oncall): I'll be watching dashboards. Ping me if we need immediate rollback. Ops tags: @deploy-team @runtime-eng.
Viktor Ivankov: Pushing a conservative canary config: max_concurrency 8, batch_window 8ms to reduce tail.
Mateo Rios: I'll ship SDK shim v1.12.1 to translate kvcache hooks; it will be transient and auto-detect runtime header x-rr-runtime-version.
Priya Sharma: Where will the shim run? edge or gateway?
Mateo Rios: Gateway edge. Small change, rollback by toggling feature flag gateway.use_runtime_shim=false
Alice Nguyen: Decision: proceed with split unpin on r-241 with shim enabled. Postmortem trigger if rollback occurs.
Jenna (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll start the prereq runbook now. Log channel for rollout: #deploy-logs-r241
ops-bot: prerollout check: all infra green, reserved GPU quota available (48/48), keystore reachable.
deploy-bot: Starting canary r-241 @2024-04-09T22:00:00Z -> canary id c-241-1 at 22:00:30Z
Alice Nguyen: canary deployed. Running smoke tests now.
Viktor Ivankov: smoke tests result: streaming pass, longseq generator passed 48/50 (2 failures — investigating).
Priya Sharma: log snippet for failures:```
[2024-04-09T22:02:14Z] request id=abc123 runtime=v2.15 seq=32768 error=kv_eviction_miss
[2024-04-09T22:05:11Z] request id=def456 runtime=v2.15 sdk=1.12 decode_err
```
Mateo Rios: Those decode_errs look like SDK shim edge-case — pushing patch to catch missing kv headers.
Jenna (oncall): With 2 failures at 5% canary, recommend pause and investigate before escalating.
Alice Nguyen: Agreed. Pausing r-241 escalation. Will block progression until we validate patched shim.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-241 paused at canary 5% by operator Alice Nguyen.
Mateo Rios: I pushed shim patch and will request a redeploy to canary c-241-1. ETA 12m.
ops-bot: redeploy scheduled for c-241-1 at 22:18:00Z (maintenance tag).
Viktor Ivankov: re-running longseq and streaming tests after redeploy.
Alice Nguyen: update in 15m. If green, we can continue with 25% after a 30min steady window. If not, rollback to v2.14.
ops-bot: Alert hook set: if p95 > baseline*1.15 or sdk-error-rate > 0.3% for 10min -> auto rollback.
deploy-bot: c-241-1 redeploy complete at 22:31:05Z.
Viktor Ivankov: smoke tests now: all checks green (longseq 50/50, streaming pass, decode_err 0).
Jenna (oncall): confirmed dashboards look stable. Proceed to 25% when you’re ready.
Alice Nguyen: escalating to 25% now. monitor window 60m.
Mateo Rios: I'll keep the shim feature flag on for 24h. Plan for removing shim after SDK 1.13 rollout next week.
Jenna (oncall): noted. Change window closes 2024-04-10T02:00:00Z. Please add release note: "Runtime v2.15 unpinned for quantized-llama3x with temporary SDK shim to preserve client compatibility."
Alice Nguyen: I'll draft the release note and add compatibility section and rollback instructions.
ops-bot: monitor window passed 60m with metrics stable. No automatic rollback triggered.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-241 escalated to 100% at 2024-04-10T00:05:22Z.
Mateo Rios: leaving shim on, will watch for any late errors.
Viktor Ivankov: running overnight health probe.
Jenna (oncall): all good from my side. Closing thread after release notes posted.
Alice Nguyen: release note posted to #releases and docs updated with compatibility note. Thanks team.
ops-bot: automated note: rollback-ready snapshot created for v2.14 (snapshot id snap-241-rollback).
Alice Nguyen: thread closed.
